scope: Pinned r177 compiler findings, not GPU or native acceptance

findings.issue: Method-chained mix uses receiver as blend factor
findings.observed: Generated GLSL placed the table row in the third mix argument and the intended factor in the second.
findings.repair: Explicit TSL mix(a,b,t) for table interpolation and rigid selection.
findings.guard: Real pinned GLSL builder assertions inspect all generated mix calls.

findings.issue: Generated native instance placement follows positionNode
findings.observed: The first shader bent local primitive vertices before per-instance translation; particles and packets therefore missed the intended world-coordinate mapping.
findings.repair: Use actual instance matrix before the curve and its bounded inverse afterward, retaining the native final placement. Larger instance arrays use updated interleaved attributes.
findings.guard: Generated classic-instance shader must access the instance before curve-table lookup and restore the instance frame afterward.

findings.repair: Shared existing render bridge restores render fields outside the curved 3D preview; four isolated bridge tests retain original arguments and return value.

native_status: Not established by compiler tests. The actual GPU fixture runs before the ordinary-input game journey.
